segments.oily: Two reviewers with oily skin describe the balm as non-greasy and moisturizing without clogging, though one felt it made no visible difference compared to a charcoal cleanser.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the balm cleanses without stripping moisture, leaving skin soft rather than tight.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report no irritation, stinging or issues with their eyes even with makeup removal.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention menopausal or aging (59-year-old) skin report visible softness and a reduced appearance of lines after use.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers in their late 50s or describing menopausal skin report the balm reduces the appearance of lines and leaves a healthy glow.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness report the balm hydrates and leaves skin soft, not tight or stripped; one reviewer nonetheless calls the texture thicker than expected.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the range helped control long-standing redness on cheeks and nose, and another notes it smooths and covers redness under makeup; one reviewer reports the product itself caused a rash and redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no irritation or stinging, including around the eyes.
concerns.spots: No reviewer specifically discusses spots or blemish outcomes from this cleansing balm.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewer specifically discusses blemish or acne outcomes from this cleansing balm.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin describe the balm as not greasy and not leaving a film, though one reports no improvement over a previous charcoal cleanser.
